name: Distinction-Preserving Configuration

data.invariance_arrows: contravariant presentation maps with authority roots
data.composability_arrows: covariant constructors with domains and residual capabilities
data.horn_classifier: R_K(h), the source-derived authorized filler object
data.pasting: partial correspondences between compatible filler objects
data.pullback_semantics: declared per evidence domain: ordinary, homotopy, or derived
data.higher_residue: oriented boundary witness for each admitted nerve
data.instrument_incidence: rho_I subset R_D x P_I x O_I

admissibility: every edge is typed and source-authorized
every required horn has a source-derived filler object
every claimed joint configuration lies in the declared ordinary/homotopy/derived compatibility pullback
every admitted pasting has a typed higher-residue disposition
base change is used only when a source-authorized comparison of horn classifiers is supplied
instrument readout is claimed only for tuples in rho_I
non_implications: locally nonempty filler objects imply a nonempty joint fiber product
preparation and detector existence implies instrument incidence
pairwise comparison cells imply higher coherence
unpointed residue implies a distinguished scalar
